description: Read a local run's steps beside the frames they produced, so the run's own verdict can be shown against its own evidence. Returns the ordered steps (action, the agent's explanation, screenshot path) plus the run's status and closing verdict. Takes a run id or a unique prefix; omit it for the most recent run. Read-only — it never modifies a session. Reach for this after a failed local run instead of parsing action-script.json by hand.

runId.description: Run id, or a unique prefix of one. Omit to read the most recent run.

name: muggle-local-run-steps-get
